identification: Framed 3D/lenticular (holographic-effect) quartz wall clock: picture of a sleeping boy in bucket hat with a beagle dog, clock dial inset at right, gold timber frame with black mount. Mass-produced 1980s-90s novelty clock, dial script brand not legible (looks like 'Fulyie'/'Fuliyi'). Catalogue: H-34 W-53 cm. Estimate 30-40, current bid $10.
marks_seen: Dial has small italic script brand under 12, illegible even zoomed. Photo 2 is a close-up of the lenticular print. No other marks.
google_searches: 3D lenticular wall clock boy sleeping with beagle dog framed quartz clock (only modern beagle clocks, no match)

entries.note: Vintage religious holographic quartz wall clock, gold frame, fixed price; same type (holographic picture clock) but different picture.

viewing_check: Low value novelty clock. Only one loosely comparable sale (A$15.55, Mar 2025). Check it runs and that the lenticular film is not scratched. Bid $10 against estimate 30-40.
searches_tried: Terapeak AU 3yr SOLD: 'holographic wall clock framed' (1 row); 'lenticular 3D wall clock' (0 rows after two waits)
flip_reason: Only 1 loosely comparable sale at about $16; current bid $10 plus 22% premium leaves no profit.

identification: Set of 3 vintage anodised aluminium kitchen canisters (graduated, blue Sugar, gold Rice, copper Coffee) with chrome lids, black knobs and black printed labels with yellow motifs. Style matches Australian 1950s-60s sets such as Jason 'Model Maid'; no maker mark seen. Estimate 30-40, current bid $15. NOTE: photos 2 and 3 in this lot's gallery are of lot 418 (Tretchikoff print), a gallery mix-up.
marks_seen: Labels SUGAR, RICE (with Chinese character and bowl motif), COFFEE. Photo 1 cuts off the third canister. No maker mark visible. Photos 2-3 show a Tretchikoff Balinese Girl print signed TRETCHIKOFF, tagged lot 418.
google_searches: vintage anodised aluminium canisters sugar rice coffee black label chrome lid bakelite knob (Jason/Model Maid, Waratah, Raco, Nylex style sets; AU$40-110 for sets)

No maker marks visible on any piece. Estimate 30-50, current bid $15.
marks_seen: BREAD embossed on door. No maker marks, labels or stamps legible on bread bin, syphon, egg cup box or bookends in either photo. Bin interior stained/rusty spots, one shelf.

identification: Vintage framed colour print of Vladimir Tretchikoff's 'Balinese Girl' (c1958, mass-produced mid-century print, 1950s-60s), signed in the print 'TRETCHIKOFF' upper right, in a white painted frame with grey slip, apparently no glass (canvas-textured surface). H-60 W-49 cm. Estimate 100-150, current bid $55. Publisher/printer (e.g. Lynch/Jansen, Frank Lynch Ltd) not visible, back not photographed.
marks_seen: Printed signature TRETCHIKOFF (photo 1637365_3, close-up of upper right, with lot ticket 418). Lot ticket on frame. Photos 1637365_2 and _3 (in lot 415's gallery) are close-ups of this print, plus own photo 1637368_1. No publisher label or back view.
google_searches: Tretchikoff 'Balinese Girl' print sold auction price Australia hammer (Leski lot est $250-350; Invaluable est A$300-400 for 77x61 framed print; South African original painting record is a different thing)

Genuine vintage prints in good condition sold $400-660 over the last 2 years (7 sales Oct 2024-Mar 2026), rising slightly; the Mar 2026 sale was $470. Estimate 100-150, bid $55. Needs careful packing for post.
searches_tried: Terapeak AU 3yr SOLD 'Tretchikoff Balinese Girl' (9 rows), 'Tretchikoff print framed' (50 rows, other titles $45-814); Google for auction results
flip_reason: 7 AU sales of the same print at $297-661 (typical about $500-600), current bid $55. Framed 60x49 cm is awkward but postable. If it wins near $100-150 plus premium, profit could be $250+; condition decides.
